title: Alarm on what you are looking at
description: From a component's vitals, start a rule on one metric, see the form name what is missing, preview it in plain words, and save it.

steps.caption: Touch Panel 2, with its vitals. Each metric has a way to raise an alarm on it.
Alarm on this opens a new rule that already reads this metric on this component.
The component is filled in, and the picker names where it sits, so two panels with one name are not mistaken.
Submit with nothing else filled in.
The form says what is missing by name, puts the focus on the first, and each name is a link to its field.
Name it. The label beneath follows, in words, until you write your own.
Poll Duration is a number, so it can be compared any way.
And only when it holds for 30 seconds.
Preview judges the draft against the last day of samples, writing nothing.
A sentence in the words you entered, naming the series by its component and metric.
The 30 seconds is named, and why the preview cannot apply it, so the counts read as the most the rule would have done.
Save it. The rule judges every sample from now on.
Its drawer reads in words first, with a link to the alarms it raises; the expressions sit behind Show expression.
